info.title: API.SH: Catawiki
info.description: The Catawiki API from API.SH: public Catawiki data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One Catawiki auction (title, status, start and close times, lot count, image) with its lots, each with its live bid as in search. `latest=true` returns the first open auction instead of an `id`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/catawiki-auction

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Auction id (e.g. `1296132`) or its catawiki.com/en/a/... link.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: `true`: the first open auction instead of an `id`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Lot order: `relevance`, `newest`, `closing`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Lots per page, 1-100 (default 24).

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency of bids and estimates (default `EUR`).

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language of titles and category names (default `en`): en, nl, de, fr, it, es, pt, pl, sv, da, fi, ru, zh, ja, ko, tr, cs, hu, ro, bg, el.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Catawiki's open auctions, all or one category's: `id`, `title`, `url`, `status` (e.g. `open_now`, `closes_today`), `start_at`, `close_at`, `lot_count`, type and theme ids, image and `raw`. 25 a page; `total` is the site's count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/catawiki-auctions

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category id (from `/catawiki/v1/categories`, e.g. `333` watches). Without it: every open auction.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language of titles and category names (default `en`): en, nl, de, fr, it, es, pt, pl, sv, da, fi, ru, zh, ja, ko, tr, cs, hu, ro, bg, el.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Catawiki's categories: without `id`, the main categories (id, name, url, parent, level, open auctions, image); with `id`, that category (with its ancestors) and its sub-categories. Category ids feed `category` in search and auctions.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/catawiki-categories

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Category id (e.g. `333` watches) for one category and its sub-categories.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language of titles and category names (default `en`): en, nl, de, fr, it, es, pt, pl, sv, da, fi, ru, zh, ja, ko, tr, cs, hu, ro, bg, el.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Catawiki lot: title, subtitle, full description (original and auto-translated), the site's summary, live `current_bid` and `bidding_end_time`, `closed`, reserve-price status, the expert's estimate (`expert_estimate` min/max), the experts, interest count, category, every specification (brand, model, period, condition, dimensions... with their ids), all images and videos, and the seller (id, name, country, pro/top flags, score, lifetime sales, member since). Closed lots stay available. `latest=true` returns the first lot of a search (`q`) instead of an `id`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/catawiki-lot

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Lot id (e.g. `108112081`) or its catawiki.com/en/l/... link.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: `true`: the first lot of a search for `q` (default `watch`) instead of an `id`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: With `latest=true`: keywords.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency of bids and estimates (default `EUR`).

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language of titles and category names (default `en`): en, nl, de, fr, it, es, pt, pl, sv, da, fi, ru, zh, ja, ko, tr, cs, hu, ro, bg, el.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The bid history of a Catawiki lot, newest first: amount and currency, the bidder as the site shows it (a pseudonym such as `Bidder 2995`, country and total bid count), whether the bid was automatic, and the time.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/catawiki-lot-bids

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Lot id (e.g. `108112081`) or its catawiki.com/en/l/... link.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Bids, 1-100 (default 50).

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency of bids and estimates (default `EUR`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Lots in Catawiki's open weekly auctions (catawiki.com: watches, art, jewellery, coins, wine, collectables...) for keywords, or all lots of a category, with every filter and sort of the search page. Each lot: `id`, `title`, `subtitle`, `url`, `image`, `auction_id`, `bidding_start_time`, the live `current_bid` (in `currency`, plus `current_bid_all` in EUR/USD/GBP), `bidding_end_time`, `closed`, `reserve_price_set`, `reserve_price_met`, `buy_now_available`, `favorite_count`, `free_shipping` and `raw`. `facets` lists every filter with its values and counts: each facet's `param` is the parameter to pass. `total` is the site's count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/catawiki-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords, e.g. `rolex`, `banksy`, `gold coin`. Optional with a single `category`.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category id(s), comma separated (from `facets` or `/catawiki/v1/categories`, e.g. `343` Rolex watches). Without `q`: exactly one id, listing that category's lots.

parameters.name: seller_country
parameters.description: Seller countries, two-letter codes, comma separated (e.g. `nl,de`; `facets` param `seller_country`).

parameters.name: reserve_price
parameters.description: `false`: only lots without a reserve price; `true`: only lots with one.

parameters.name: closing_date
parameters.description: Closing dates `YYYY-MM-DD`, comma separated (`facets` param `closing_date`).

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest current bid in EUR (whole number).

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest current bid in EUR (whole number).

parameters.name: filter_<id>
parameters.description: Any other filter of `facets` (brand, object, material, period, condition, colour, style, signature, case diameter...): `filter_` + the facet `id` with value ids, comma separated, e.g. `filter_909=60922` (brand Rolex).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `relevance` (default), `newest` (recently listed), `closing` (closing soon).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Lots per page, 1-100 (default 24).

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency of bids and estimates (default `EUR`).

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language of titles and category names (default `en`): en, nl, de, fr, it, es, pt, pl, sv, da, fi, ru, zh, ja, ko, tr, cs, hu, ro, bg, el.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Catawiki seller's profile: name, url, pro and top-seller flags, member since, country and city, review score with positive/neutral/negative counts for the last 12 months and lifetime review count, objects sold, lots in auction now, badges, bio (with the site's translations) and terms link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/catawiki-seller

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Seller id (`seller.id` of a lot, e.g. `2606741`) or the catawiki.com/en/u/... link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/catawiki-seller-reviews

get.description:
Search suggestions for what was typed, as the Catawiki search box shows them.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/catawiki-suggest

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The text typed so far, e.g. `rol`.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language of titles and category names (default `en`): en, nl, de, fr, it, es, pt, pl, sv, da, fi, ru, zh, ja, ko, tr, cs, hu, ro, bg, el.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
